propositions: Serena symbol tools are deferred by default, requiring a ToolSearch round-trip before first use, while non-deferred tools like Bash cost zero discovery steps, creating friction asymmetry that favors cheaper tools regardless of guidance

ENABLE_TOOL_SEARCH is a global all-or-nothing control (true|false|auto|auto:N) settable via .claude/settings.json env block, with no per-server or per-tool non-deferral lever, making the original <=4-tool limitation not implementable

Loading all Serena schemas (not just three named tools) costs a measured minimum of +25,454 tokens (serena-only baseline) to +63,852 tokens (four connected servers), justified by the cost of the defect it prevents plus the one-line revert mechanism
A tracked .claude/settings.json with gitignore negation allows repo-committed ENABLE_TOOL_SEARCH configuration while keeping .claude/ otherwise ignored for operator-local files
